title: Catalog-led: a large assortment shopped by category and spec
when: Hundreds of products; buyers search and browse rather than read.

steps.when: a large assortment: catalog button, mega menu, wide search

variants.when: a short flat menu and a left-aligned look (journal, dense catalog)
a flat menu of up to 6-8 short items: the categories show on desktop

steps.when: a catalogue look: the hero inside the grid with the theme's rounding

variants.when: photography with a quiet zone for the live text
a photo and a colour panel side by side (playful, premium)

steps.note: 3-5 columns, 4:3 or 1:1, linked. Its title is a phrase about what the store sells: the storefront makes it the page's H1 (a banner title never is).

variants.when: more than 4 categories
two departments or audiences (women and men, adults and kids)
one curated row of 4
a designed band between shelves, container width
a text band with a button and no image (kit-custom-sections)
new arrivals or bestsellers, 12 cards

steps.when: considered purchases: 3-4 real numbers (years, customers, materials) (kit-custom-sections)
steps.note: The signature block: one block that only this store has, chosen by the look (references/looks.md).

variants.when: dark drop and playful: a running line of short brand words (kit-custom-sections)
gallery and dense catalog: a mosaic of products or collections in tiles of different sizes (kit-custom-sections)
native fallback: two large images between the shelves with an overlay title

steps.when: bigger cards for the second source, a change of rhythm

variants.when: new arrivals or bestsellers, 12 cards

steps.when: the default story: eyebrow, a heading phrase, 16 px text at 560-640 px, a button to a real page, a 1:1 or 3:4 photo (`mediaRatio`; kit-custom-sections)
steps.note: One story block in the middle third that leads somewhere: a button or a last-line link to the catalog, a collection or the About page.

variants.when: native fallback the merchant edits in the cabinet: a narrowed section, `###` heading, one paragraph of 300 characters or less ending with a link
no photo for the story: one centred statement of 100-200 characters ending with a link

steps.when: native fallback: text cards alternating with photos

variants.when: benefits with icons and live text, no photos (kit-custom-sections)

steps.when: customer photos, stores or press the merchant has
steps.note: Certificates only if every tile is real.

variants.when: one strong real review with a name and a photo (kit-custom-sections)
brands carried, press or partner logos (multi-brand, B2B)

steps.when: a centred form on a neutral band (centred themes)

variants.when: text left, form right: the usual closing band
on the footer palette, so the subscription and the footer read as one closing block
off-white, grey or cream: soft and premium looks
